comment: InvocationContext.getConstructor() returns a java.lang.reflect.Constructor of the target class, which the specification leaves no way around. Only an interceptor that asks for the constructor needs this; an @AroundConstruct method that does not is free of it.
name: io.micronaut.interceptor.test.construct.BuiltService

comment: InvocationContext.getMethod() returns the lifecycle callback of the intercepted class as a java.lang.reflect.Method. Only a lifecycle callback interceptor that asks for the method needs this; one that does not is free of it.
name: io.micronaut.interceptor.test.lifecycle.ManagedService
